notes.title: Opening of the Hall of Fame Update
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

The world of Singoru never stands still! On the horizon are new challenges, fresh opportunities, and even more reasons to prove yourself. And the greatest of these will be the opening of the Hall of Fame — a place where only the best of the best will remain. It is time to see what has changed in Singoru — we are sure that each of you will find something for yourself!
[hr][/hr]New Building: Hall of Fame
A historic event has taken place in our town!
The Hall of Fame has been solemnly opened — a place where the names of the greatest Braves are immortalized. Now you can prove to everyone that your name shines brighter than all among the legends!

The Hall of Fame takes into account much more than just profile level. The ranking system reflects everything that makes a player a true legend: player progress, victories over bosses, portal discoveries, and acquired equipment. To have your name appear in the Hall of Fame, it is enough to log in after the update — because only the achievements of active players are counted.

As we mentioned earlier in our diaries, over time the Hall of Fame will develop, gain new features, and become more and more interesting. Ahead await seasons and leagues, new stages, and of course, rewards. For being in the lead is already an achievement, and receiving a worthy reward for it is doubly pleasant.
[hr][/hr]Hall of Fame Rankings
Masters of Progress — Profile Level
The higher your current profile level, the higher your position in the overall list. The metric is simple and clear: as the profile level grows, the place in the Hall of Fame also rises.

Titan Hunters — Boss Kills
Glory points are awarded for victories over bosses and scale based on:

the difficulty of the location (the harder the location, the more points);

the order of the boss in the location (defeating the final boss gives more points than the first).

Lords of Aether — Portal Discoveries
Ranking for opening aether portals:

points are awarded for opening portals;

time-limited portals, opened with Prisms of Eternity, bring more ranking points.

Forges of Fate — Equipment Acquisition
Points are awarded for obtaining equipment items from various sources:

the higher the rarity and star rating of the item, the more points you receive;

the method of obtaining equipment also affects the number of points.

Clans
A separate section has already been reserved and will appear in future updates.

⚠️ Important: Titan Hunter and Lord of Aether rankings will not take into account past merits in the world of Singoru.

For all Braves the conditions will be equal: no one will gain an advantage from old merits, and the final place in the ranking will depend only on your actions after the opening of the Hall of Fame.
Now everything is in your hands — prove your mastery and earn the right to be called the best Titan Hunter or try on the crown of the Lord of Aether!
[hr][/hr]Adjustments to Unholy Barrier and Throwing Disk Evolutions
An error was discovered in which modifiers from passive abilities were not applied to the evolutions “You Shall Not Pass!” and “Queen’s Song” if the player learned these passive abilities after obtaining the evolutions themselves.

Now the system works correctly:

If the evolution was obtained earlier and the passive ability that affects this evolution was learned later, the modifiers will still be applied. The evolutions “You Shall Not Pass!” and “Queen’s Song” will receive bonuses to damage, area of effect, projectile speed, and so on.
[hr][/hr]Simplification of Early Stages of the Game
Health and Attack values of monsters have been reduced in several Normal mode locations:

Forest (from Easy to Hell difficulties),

Laboratory (from Easy to Hell difficulties),

Graveyard (from Easy to Hard difficulties),

Mycelium (Easy difficulty).

The frequency of receiving touch damage from monsters has been reduced by 2 times.

These changes are aimed at making the early stage of the game more comfortable for new players and speeding up progress in the first locations. Now the first steps in Singoru will become easier, and mastering the basic mechanics more comfortable.
[hr][/hr]Hero Rebalance
Clara:

Added a new specialization that allows, upon a successful dodge, to increase the hero’s movement speed by 30% for 1 second.
[hr][/hr]Mysterious Code
In honor of the release of the update, we are giving you a mysterious code: HALLOFFAME

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/ac8bd3548349f6206a91d611421d16d3c8964c7f.png"]
[hr][/hr]
That is all for now, Brave Ones. We hope that you will appreciate the new features! Stay with us, share your impressions of the game — we are always happy to hear feedback and make the game even better!

Success to you on your path to glory — and may the Hall of Fame preserve the memory of your victories!

Brave ones!



We’re back again to tell you about all the latest updates in The Braves! So, put on your armor, grab your best weapon — and off to new adventures! It’s time to reveal what’s in store for you.


Updated Base Screen


The main base screen has been revamped and now looks a bit different. In the updated base, you’ll notice some new details, including mysterious ruins. These ruins will become the foundation of a future building — the Hall of Fame. At that very place the legends and achievements of the greatest heroes will be kept, and the building itself will be available for construction in one of the upcoming updates.
But that’s not all. While you’re exploring the updated base screen, brave heroes have already set out to scout the lands surrounding the city. Their mission is to find the perfect spot for building a brand-new mine. Previously, the base had an old mine building, but it turned out to be just an empty shell with no valuable resources. But soon, however, you’ll uncover a true discovery — the Mine will appear right on the location map, and who knows what resources and secrets it might reveal?
And remember: this is just the start! The updated base is only the first step. Future updates will bring even more new buildings and features, turning our town into a true fortress and a center of power.


New Event: Back to School

notes.title: The "Era of Stars" update
notes.notes:
Brave ones!

We are pleased to present to you the new major update for The Braves! We have a lot of news, big and small, so let’s not waste any time and dive straight into what awaits you!


Star Coins Drop
 Brave ones, the moment has come to test your valor!

Starting today, Star Coins have become the official reward for defeating bosses in Hardcore mode! But that’s just the beginning — soon this rare currency will become part of another unique mode. Stay tuned for updates!  Show what you're capable of — challenge the strongest opponents, face the harshest trials, and earn this truly rare currency, which will find wide use across the Singoru realms!

Let the stars witness your feats!


New Armor: Star Fortress Set
Since the Ether began calling heroes, the world has changed. Not suddenly — more like someone started a long-forgotten mechanism. The gears of fate, resting for centuries, have begun to turn again.  Strange creatures appeared, unstable portals opened, mysterious artifacts and enigmatic coins were discovered. They were called Star Coins — for their shimmering light and the feeling that each one contains a fragment of something distant and powerful.  The material of these coins turned out to be unusual. It was melted down, studied, and combined with other metals. Thus, the Star Fortress Set was born — a full set of armor created for those who face death without flinching.  What advantages does the Star Fortress Set offer, you ask? Let’s break it down:


Star Fortress Armor  
+6% health at uncommon rarity  

+16% health at rare rarity  

Reduces incoming damage by +10% at epic rarity  

+32% chance for experience drop from enemies at legendary rarity  

+0.28% armor for each percentage of missing health at mythical rarity

-9.9% cooldown time for abilities at epic rarity  

+7 seconds to invulnerability duration after resurrection at legendary rarity  

+20% experience gained at mythical rarity

+7.7% movement speed at legendary rarity

+5.5% skill range at epic rarity  

+4% damage per evolution of active skill at legendary rarity  

30% chance of double damage for all evolutions at mythical rarity


Star Fortress Ring  
+6% attack at uncommon rarity  

+15% attack at rare rarity  

Additional skill restrictions in the match: 4 at epic rarity  

10% chance to restore 10% health upon taking damage at legendary rarity 

 +1 passive skill slot at mythical rarity


Full Set Bonus  
+2 Resurrections

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/5c03222ae7bdbd931d1115b68c7c0bedd030c9ce.png"]

Attention! This set is only available in the "Equipment" tab in the Market building and can be purchased with Star Coins.


More Control in Battle
Braves, meet one of the most useful combat interface improvements!  No more guessing and missed rotations — each active unique ability is now accompanied by a clear timer showing exactly how many seconds are left before the next use.

Even if you're just starting your journey in The Braves, the updated interface will help you get up to speed with battle mechanics faster. And if you're a veteran — your tactical play will become even more precise and confident.  Forward, Braves! Your abilities are now fully under control!


Rebalancing Frost Shards
We closely monitor how abilities perform in battle and listen to your feedback. Thanks to this, one of the old abilities has been reworked, retaining its core concept but gaining new, more efficient mechanics. We are talking about the Frost Shards and their evolution — Explosive Shards.

Previously, the shards always fired straight behind the character in a straight line. Now, they home in on the nearest enemies behind you, prioritizing those closest to the character. If there are several targets behind you, the Frost Shards will be evenly distributed among them when the ability is activated.

These changes also apply to Explosive Shards.


Notifications
You asked — we added it!  Now, all important updates are marked with notifications — those little red dots that appear on buttons, tabs, and icons when:

You receive a new piece of equipment or hero

You have enough shards to upgrade a hero's rarity

New slots open in the market or bank

New features or important events appear  

With them, it’s easier: you don’t need to search for anything — the game will guide you on where to look.  Navigation has become faster, and gameplay even more convenient!


New Academy Branch: Summoning
The Academy continues to develop, and now there is a new branch of study — specifically for summoner heroes!  The Summoning branch opens up unique abilities that strengthen summoned minions in battle.

Several heroes have reconsidered their paths and switched their specialization. Now their primary focus will be Summoning, rather than Attack, Defense, or Support, as it was before.

We present to you a list of these heroes:

Terra

Sylpha

Calizk

Jabir 

These heroes will gain access to the unique abilities of the Summoning branch and become stronger as summoners on the battlefield through their minions.

What about the resources already invested in training these heroes, you ask? The answer is simple: we will reset the upgraded skills in the Academy and return all runes and gold spent in full. This way, you can redistribute them as you see fit!

To train heroes in the Summoning branch, you will need new Summoning Runes and gold coins.  Summoning Runes can be obtained just like other runes:

In the market, as a regular resource

At points of interest during matches

By defeating bosses

By opening event chests

Or you can buy sets in the bank — quick and convenient!


Hero Rebalance
Jabir:  With the arrival of Roxy in the world of Singoru, Jabir's times have become difficult. He quickly realized that he was outmatched by the innate talent of the young demoness in controlling living flame. But he was not ready to give up.  In search of new weapons, he turned to ancient legends of a powerful artifact that grants control over fire. That’s when he found the magical lamp — the Wishbringer. And now, he has a chance to prove that skill earned through hard work surpasses any innate abilities.

You can already find the new skins in the Tavern and acquire them with Transformation Masks, Gemstones, Star Coins, or in new Bank offers!


Hot New Arrivals at the Goblin Bank!
Step into the “Best” section — rare goods are waiting for you at irresistibly good prices. Don’t miss your chance to stock up and snatch up the best deals and offer chains that are sure to win you over!

 
 New Portal Openings

notes.title: Wind of Change Update!
notes.notes:
Brave ones!

We present to your attention a major new update for The Braves! We have lots of news, both big and small, so let's not waste time and quickly find out what awaits you!

New modes: Chase and Invasion

We've prepared a series of new challenges for you - location modes. Each mode will specialize in a specific type of resource. So if you need hero manga to strengthen your heroes, then welcome to the "Chase" mode. And if you need construction materials for your base or runes for training at the Academy, it's better to choose the "Invasion" mode.
These modes are available in all locations, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be met to unlock them.
All game modes are available in each location, but certain conditions in normal and hardcore modes must be completed to unlock them.

The progression system is built logically: for example, to unlock the "Invasion" mode in the "Forest" location on "Easy" difficulty, you first need to complete the "Easy" level in the "Graveyard" location in normal mode.

Important note: resistance levels may vary even within the same location.
Don't worry about planning your path - the game will clearly show which stages and at what difficulty level need to be completed to unlock new opportunities.

Let's take a closer look at each of the new modes:

"Chase" mode

Something incredible has happened in Singoru. The monsters that used to act chaotically have suddenly united around the strongest. They have chosen leaders for themselves - powerful creatures that they began to worship as deities. These leaders are not only smarter and stronger than their brethren, but also have a magical connection with ancient altars that grant them immortality.
We've tried to make each match in "Chase" mode unique. Each location has its own leader monster with special abilities and behavior tactics.

How the new mode works:

From the very beginning of the match, an immortal leader monster will be chasing you. It cannot be killed in the usual way - it will pursue you until the altars connected to it are destroyed. But be careful: the monster won't just follow you. It will use its abilities to block paths, slow you down, or even call for reinforcements.

Main objective - act quickly. Explore the location, find the altars and destroy them before the monster catches up with you. But remember: the enemy won't sit idly by! The longer you delay, the more dangerous the situation becomes. And if you don't manage to sever the monster leader's connection with the altars by the end of the match, you will lose this battle.

"Invasion" mode

The standard rules no longer apply - now every match turns into a task to eliminate the threat. Ready for a real challenge? We present the new "Invasion" mode - dynamic, intense, requiring not only strength but also a well-thought-out strategy.

How the new mode works:

At the beginning of the game, portals appear in the location and you have 5 minutes to destroy them and defeat the guardians - the Ethereal Hounds.
The higher the difficulty, the more stages: from one to three, each lasting 5 minutes.
Let's look at Easy difficulty: as soon as you appear in the location, a countdown timer starts. Portals appear on the map, and within the allotted 5 minutes of the stage you need to destroy the portals and defeat the invaders that appear from these very portals. If the portals or Ethereal Hounds are not destroyed when time runs out - it counts as a defeat.
If you manage to destroy the portals and Ethereal Hounds within the allotted time, then at the end of each stage you will face the location boss containing coveted resources and equipment.

Match duration changes

Changes have occurred in the world of Singoru! Match durations have been shortened, making them more dynamic and exciting. This innovation not only speeds up gameplay but also makes it more thrilling. Now you'll have more opportunities to test your skills in a short time and enjoy every moment on the battlefield!
Let's see how much time it will take:

 Easy difficulty level of Normal mode, Chase and Invasion modes can be completed in just 5 minutes;
 Medium - in 10 minutes;
 Hard, Impossible and Infernal - in just 15 minutes;
 Hardcore mode match duration remains unchanged at 15 minutes.

With the reduction in match duration, the number of bosses in locations has also changed:

 On Easy difficulty - 1 boss
 On Medium difficulty - 2 bosses
 On Hard, Impossible and Infernal - 3 bosses

What about rewards, you ask? Although there are fewer bosses, the amount of rewards remains the same. So you'll be able to get the same resources and equipment items in less time!

Prism fragments turn into star coins

We've carefully analyzed your feedback and would like to note the impressive efficiency of some players in collecting prism fragments. Unfortunately, the number of fragments obtained has significantly exceeded our expectations, creating a certain imbalance in the game economy.

We've also noticed that the current fragment usage system turned out to be quite limited and didn't provide sufficient variety of gameplay opportunities. We strive to offer you broader prospects and diverse options for using in-game currency.

Considering your comments that the ability to obtain resources for summoning heroes and weapons is wonderful, but gameplay shouldn't be limited to just this, we've decided to make significant changes. We're abandoning prism fragments and introducing a new currency - Star Coins.

In return, we're introducing a more flexible system where Star Coins can be used to purchase a wide range of in-game items and opportunities. This will make gameplay more varied and exciting, giving you more choices and opportunities for development.

At this stage of implementing Star Coins, you can expect:

 Hero fragments in the "Hero Fragments" section of the Market
 Transformation Masks in the "Resources" section of the Market
 Various character appearances in the Tavern
 Ether and Infinity Prisms in the Bank and Market buildings at the following rates:
 Ether Prism - 150 Star Coins
 Infinity Prism - 300 Star Coins

All prism fragments you currently have will be automatically converted into the new currency - Star Coins at a 1:1 ratio.

In the future, we plan to expand the list of available items for Star Coins to make your gameplay even more exciting and varied.

Join the new era of Singoru and enjoy the updated economy system!

Gift Marathon: Monthly

Monthly

The Monthly Gift Marathon starts with the first monthly marathon that will last 28 days, after which it will switch to a cyclical mode.
The Monthly Gift Marathon will offer you 28 days of continuous reward collection. No tasks - just log into the game and claim your daily bonuses.
After completing the main stage, the gift marathon will switch to cyclical mode, where the rewards will change, but you'll be able to receive them using the familiar scheme. This will allow you to plan your time and always know when to expect new gifts.
No need to complete complex conditions or special requirements - just play and receive your bonuses. If you want more, we've prepared a premium part of the marathon with additional bonuses.

Sight customization

Now you can flexibly customize your sight in the game.

Auto-aim - the classic mode where the game automatically helps you acquire targets. Perfect for dynamic shootouts and beginners.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/a1431e8bb4059b648fdd4b65a748aa1c9c666390.gif

Cursor aiming - advanced mode with full control over shots. Now you can precisely direct weapons through the cursor, which is especially important for experienced players.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8ecba610a3435cf7c851684638ff456ac541aed0.gif

We've added a convenient switch so you can choose the most comfortable aiming method. On PC, you have two options:

 Directly in battle by pressing a special button (F).
 Through game settings.

In the mobile version, which will be released soon, you'll only be able to change the aiming mode through the settings menu.

The new feature currently only affects certain skills. We've compiled their list:

 Stone Shrapnel

The choice is yours! Customize the aiming type to suit your playstyle. Remember: in cursor aiming mode, shot accuracy depends entirely on your skills and experience.

Changes to Daily Roulette Rewards

No more "7500"! Now the size of the daily reward in coveted gold coins depends on your progress in locations:

Go forth, meet adventure, and challenge the monster leaders and alien invaders. After all, only you can protect Singoru from the forces of evil!

Pity Counter

Previously, the guarantee for obtaining a legendary hero or equipment item in Portals had to be tracked manually. Now we've implemented an automatic pity counter for the Portal building and event activities in the Market building!
This innovation will allow you to easily see how many summon attempts remain until guaranteed receipt of a legendary hero or equipment item, making the summoning process more convenient and transparent!

Resource Conversion for Gems

How to use it: Simply click the hero upgrade button in the Tavern building, even if you don't have enough Hero Manga volumes to upgrade the hero, and the game will automatically offer to purchase the missing resources for Gems.

notes.title: Snow update!
notes.notes:
Brave Ones!

We present to your attention the new update of The Braves! We have a lot of news again, so let's not waste time and jump headfirst into the maelstrom of new products!

New location-Ridge!

There are all sorts of rumors and legends about the snow-capped mountains of Singoru. Poets and storytellers described this place as the Backbone of the World. Those who have ever visited these places will never be able to get them out of their minds. Natural beauty mixed with dangers waiting at every turn will not leave indifferent even the most sophisticated heroes. 
You will find a lot of new monsters, bosses and, of course, generous rewards for defeating them! 
And for those brave men who have reached the pinnacle of skill in normal mode, they are already waiting in Hardcore Ridge. 

 New Achievements:

Opening a new location can mean not only new adventures, but also new challenges and achievements! Test your luck and skills, try to collect them all!

 New quests:

New tasks are already ready for the Town Hall task board, both for normal and Hardcore modes. Those brave men who have already completed all the tasks before them will be able to fill their wallets with pleasant and useful rewards! 

Scrolling through task chapters in the Town Hall:

Would you like to know what challenges await you in the future? Now this is as easy as scrolling through several chapters of tasks in advance. The game has a new feature that allows you to view not yet available chapters in the Town Hall and complete tasks in advance.

Frame Rate limit:

You asked — we did it! In the game settings, you can now choose to limit the number of frames per second: 30, 60, 100, or no limits. Enjoy the adventure according to your own rules.

In addition, we have done everything possible to make it as comfortable as possible for you to play. Now you can collect rewards with just one click. You no longer need to collect each reward individually — this saves you time and simplifies the game process.

Updated Loading Screens:

The best artists of Singoru (who had not yet had time to eat the terrible monsters) tirelessly painted portraits of heroes who are led into battle by Brave Men. Meet the updated loading screens and the new Braves logo. We hope that you will like them. 
Hints have also been added during loading. So you can not only enjoy new works of art, but also learn something new!

New building appearance:

Is it a shame when you build and build, but the appearance of your buildings does not change? Stop putting up with it! We've added new building looks for level 21-25. All this is designed to make your eyes enjoy something truly new!

Disabling markers in a match:

In the heat of battle, it can sometimes be difficult to focus because of the many markers and pointers. We understand that! Now, by clicking just one button, you can hide (and then show again) all placemarks related to points of interest and auxiliary items.

Symbol Abbreviation:

We've all had it happen that when we looked at the amount of resources needed to reach a new Town Hall level, we couldn't tell if it was hundreds of thousands or millions. Even too lazy to count how many zeros and ones there are.
Now large numbers will be presented in a more convenient way. Instead of a lot of zeros and ones, we will see only the first few digits of the number with a postscript. For example, 100M or 10K. However, if you hover over the number you are interested in, you can still see the exact number of resources.

Also we give you a mystic code in honor of the update:  ridgewinds

Well, that's all the news for today. Wait for more updates, read our diaries and just enjoy life in Singoru. After all, you are Brave and you can do anything!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png

Here is a list of the rewards you can receive: gold coins, gemstones, prism fragments, as well as full-fledged Ether and Eternity prisms.
 We also want to draw your attention to the fact that now, during technical work on the server, the corresponding notification will appear in the game, allowing you to plan your game activity in advance.
 A new resource has been added to the game - prism fragments. They are used to exchange for full Ether and Eternity Prisms. The exchange rate of prism fragments at the Bank is stable. This way you can exchange 100 fragments for one Ether Prism, or 200 fragments for one Eternity Prism. On the Market, you may come across a more profitable offer with a discount, don't forget to check the blueprints and resources tab with each market update!
 The "Hardcore" mode challenges the bravest and most experienced heroes. Only by overcoming incredible difficulties, they will be able to reach new heights in liberating the world of Singoru from the forces of evil.

This mode offers three difficulty levels:
[olist]
 Daring
 Brutal
 Extreme
[/olist]

But that's not all, if you're lucky, you'll be able to get parts of the unique Conqueror armor set as a reward for killing bosses, which can only be found in this mode.

Matches will last only 15 minutes, regardless of the chosen difficulty and location.
Rewards for completing all stages of the mode will be much richer than for regular matches.
To successfully complete the match, choosing a favorite hero will no longer be enough. You will need to develop a whole strategy, paying close attention not only to the equipment, but also to the heroes themselves and their elemental abilities.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png

 We haven't forgotten about the quests for adventurers. A new chain of quests for the new mode has appeared in the Town Hall. Go forward, to meet the adventures that will definitely captivate you.
 The buildings of our village have also undergone pleasant changes: the Town Hall, Tavern and Forge have received new levels for upgrades, now they can be upgraded up to level 25 maximum. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44309290/8591e76514c2f1bd851ef51cdec1e3797704a8cb.png

 We have increased the maximum level for heroes, as well as added new "stars" to improve the characteristics of mythic items. This will allow you to create truly unique and powerful equipment sets.

 Mythic weapons and armor will receive their own star levels, reaching a peak of 5 stars. Each star on your mythic equipment will increase the maximum level by 5 points, allowing you to cope with new dangers!

The cost of upgrading items and heroes at these levels has been slightly increased. But don't worry, those who have already upgraded their mythic equipment to levels 95 and above will receive their resources back in full, according to the new prices.
 In addition, a comprehensive optimization of the game was carried out, improving its performance and smoothness even on less powerful devices.
 And the chance of equipment dropping in locations has become higher, now dressing up your heroes at the initial stage of the game will become even easier. The resistance of monsters to elements at high difficulty levels has also been increased. Points of interest will provide more in-match advantages, and the reward for killing a boss will be significantly increased.
 And 29 new achievements have been added to really challenge you!
